meta.title: When more than 20 users can see the PR, typing finds the rest

steps.note: Open Purchase Requisitions as the starting screen for the PR assignment flow.
Stay on the Open tab, where PR-1 can be searched and assigned.
Select PR-1 so its assignment controls become available.

args.goal: on the Open Purchase Requisitions screen, search for PR-1 if needed, select one PR-1 line item, click the Assign person icon next to Upload PRs, verify the Search a user picker initially shows at most 20 names, type the name of an allowed user who is not in the initial list, verify that user is found, and verify a user who cannot see PR-1 is not found; leave the picker showing the search result

steps.note: Perform and observe the assignment picker interaction that no catalog domain step exposes.
Confirm the assignment picker and its search field remain visible after the search behavior is exercised.
